Name: DE-EstimatesBillingConditions
Statement:
select  bic.Oid as BillingConditionId,
        est.Oid as EstimateId,
        est.Number + ' - ' + est.Name as Estimate,
        est.Number as EstimateNumber,
        bic.BillingClient as BillingClientId,
        bcl.NameAndExternalId as BillingClient,
        bic.[Type],
        bic.Frequency,
        pmc.Name as PaymentCondition,
        bic.PaymentCondition as PaymentConditionId,
        bic.AmountType,
        bic.[Percentage],
        bic.[Value],
        bic.YourReference,
        bic.Date,
        bic.DayOfMonth,
        bic.DayOfWeek,
        est.Company as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        est.Client as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client
from    BillingCondition bic
            left join PaymentCondition pmc on bic.PaymentCondition = pmc.Oid
            join Client bcl on bcl.Oid = bic.BillingClient
            join Estimate est on est.Oid = bic.Estimate
            join CommercialClient cli on cli.Oid = est.Client
            join Company com on com.Oid = est.Company
